title: Hanging Death Classification Tracker
description: How US jurisdictions classify hanging deaths. Records official rulings and documented disputes. Does not assess whether any ruling is correct.

cases.description_html: Individual case records. verification='unverified' means not yet reviewed. official_manner records what an authority ruled, as fact. family_contests and org_contests record that a dispute exists and who is making it. Neither is a verdict.

mortality_agg.description: CDC WONDER aggregates. A suppressed cell means fewer than 10 deaths, never zero.

candidates.description: Raw automated news hits awaiting human triage. Not findings.
